invariants.rationale: The method returns false if disabled is true, otherwise true.
If the method returns false, it must be because disabled is true.
If the method returns true, keyRepeatTask.cancel() has been called, so the task is cancelled.
If the method returns false (early), keyRepeatTask.cancel() is not called, so isCancelled() may be false.
Method requires a non-null InputEvent as a parameter (typical invariant for event handlers).
